arbaeen_ahadith.front: Who narrates the ḥadīth of creation in the womb (Arbaʿīn 4)?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA — one of the best-known Companions

arbaeen_ahadith.front: What is the kunya of ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān — <bdi>أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ</bdi>

arbaeen_ahadith.front: How early did ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA accept Islam?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: Among the very first to accept it

arbaeen_ahadith.text: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA served the Prophet ﷺ as {{c1::his personal attendant}}: he would {{c2::carry his shoes}}, {{c3::cover him while he bathed}}, and {{c4::wake him when he slept}}

arbaeen_ahadith.front: For what was ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA among the best of the Companions?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: Reciting the Qurʾān

arbaeen_ahadith.text: The Companions learned the Qurʾān {{c1::ten verses}} at a time, and did not move on until {{c2::they had understood them and put them into practice}}

arbaeen_ahadith.front: When the Prophet ﷺ asked ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA to recite to him, which sūrah did he recite?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: Sūrat al-Nisāʾ

arbaeen_ahadith.front: At which verse did the Prophet ﷺ stop ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA's recitation of al-Nisāʾ?
arbaeen_ahadith.back:
فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَٰؤُلَاءِ شَهِيدًا
“So how will it be when We bring from every community a witness, and bring you, O Muḥammad, as a witness against these?” — al-Nisāʾ 4:41

arbaeen_ahadith.front: When ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA reached al-Nisāʾ 4:41 — “how will it be when We bring from every community a witness…” — how did the Prophet ﷺ respond?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: His eyes overflowed with tears, and he said, “That is enough now”

arbaeen_ahadith.front: Whose manners did ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA closely resemble?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: The Prophet's ﷺ

arbaeen_ahadith.text: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA made {{c1::both hijrahs — to Abyssinia and to Madinah}}, and fought in {{c2::every battle}}

arbaeen_ahadith.front: What part did ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA play in the death of Abū Jahl at Badr?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: He finished him off — two young men of the Anṣār had already struck Abū Jahl down, and Ibn Masʿūd found him dying

arbaeen_ahadith.front: Where did ʿUmar RA send ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA, and to do what?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: To Kufa, to teach

arbaeen_ahadith.front: Roughly how many ḥadīth did ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA narrate?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: About 840 — the figure usually given is 848

arbaeen_ahadith.front: To which Companion do the Ḥanafīs trace their madhhab?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA

arbaeen_ahadith.front: How does ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd RA describe the Prophet ﷺ as he opens the ḥadīth of creation in the womb?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: “The truthful, the one believed” — <bdi>الصَّادِقُ المَصْدُوقُ</bdi>
arbaeen_ahadith.source: Arbaʿīn Ḥadīth 4 — the text in translation

arbaeen_ahadith.text: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, each person's creation is gathered in the womb as {{c1::a <bdi>نُطْفَة</bdi> (nuṭfah)}} for forty days, then becomes {{c2::an <bdi>عَلَقَة</bdi> (ʿalaqah)}} for the same, then {{c3::a <bdi>مُضْغَة</bdi> (muḍghah)}} for the same
arbaeen_ahadith.source: Arbaʿīn Ḥadīth 4 — the text in translation

arbaeen_ahadith.front: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, after how many days is the soul breathed into the fetus?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: 120 — three stages of forty days each
arbaeen_ahadith.source: Arbaʿīn Ḥadīth 4 — the text in translation

arbaeen_ahadith.front: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, who breathes the soul into the fetus?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: The angel sent to it
arbaeen_ahadith.source: Arbaʿīn Ḥadīth 4 — the text in translation

arbaeen_ahadith.text: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, the angel is commanded to write four things: {{c1::sustenance — <bdi>رِزْق</bdi>}}, {{c2::lifespan — <bdi>أَجَل</bdi>}}, {{c3::deeds — <bdi>عَمَل</bdi>}}, and {{c4::whether wretched or happy — <bdi>شَقِيّ أَمْ سَعِيد</bdi>}}
arbaeen_ahadith.extra: In the order of the ḥadīth.
arbaeen_ahadith.source: Arbaʿīn Ḥadīth 4 — the text in translation

arbaeen_ahadith.front: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, what does the Prophet ﷺ say just before describing how people's lives end?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: He swears an oath: “By Allah, besides whom there is no god”
arbaeen_ahadith.source: Arbaʿīn Ḥadīth 4 — the text in translation

arbaeen_ahadith.text: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, one of you does the deeds of the people of Paradise until there is only {{c1::a forearm's length — <bdi>ذِرَاع</bdi>}} between him and it; then {{c2::what has been written overtakes him}}, and {{c3::he does the deeds of the people of the Fire and enters it}}
arbaeen_ahadith.source: Arbaʿīn Ḥadīth 4 — the text in translation

arbaeen_ahadith.front: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, what is the reverse of the one who does the deeds of the people of Paradise and ends in the Fire?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: One who does the deeds of the people of the Fire until only a forearm's length remains; then what is written overtakes him, and he does the deeds of the people of Paradise and enters it
arbaeen_ahadith.source: Arbaʿīn Ḥadīth 4 — the text in translation

arbaeen_ahadith.front: Which collections relate the ḥadīth of creation in the womb?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: Both al-Bukhārī and Muslim — it is <bdi>مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ</bdi> (muttafaq ʿalayh)
arbaeen_ahadith.source: Arbaʿīn Ḥadīth 4 — the text in translation

arbaeen_ahadith.front: The ḥadīth of creation in the womb describes the fetus's stages. What is that description counted as evidence of?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: The Prophet's ﷺ prophethood — it is one of its proofs

arbaeen_ahadith.front: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, what is the <bdi>نُطْفَة</bdi> (nuṭfah)?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: The mixture of male and female fluid in the womb — usually translated “drop”

arbaeen_ahadith.front: In modern terms, what do some take the <bdi>نُطْفَة</bdi> stage of the ḥadīth of creation in the womb to be?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: The zygote — the sperm and the egg combined

arbaeen_ahadith.front: What does <bdi>عَلَقَة</bdi> (ʿalaqah), the second stage in the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, mean?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: A suspended or clinging thing; a clot

arbaeen_ahadith.front: What happens to the embryo during the <bdi>عَلَقَة</bdi> stage of the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, in modern terms?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: The fertilized egg implants in the wall of the uterus and clings to it

arbaeen_ahadith.front: What does <bdi>مُضْغَة</bdi> (muḍghah), the third stage in the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, mean?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: A chewed lump; a lump of flesh — what the embryo looks like at that stage

arbaeen_ahadith.front: Besides the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, where are the stages <bdi>نُطْفَة</bdi>, <bdi>عَلَقَة</bdi> and <bdi>مُضْغَة</bdi> described?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: In the Qurʾān — e.g. al-Muʾminūn 23:13–14

arbaeen_ahadith.front: Why is the breathing-in of the soul, in the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, taken as the moment the fetus is given life?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: Because the soul — <bdi>الرُّوح</bdi> — is what gives a human being life

arbaeen_ahadith.text: Two definitions of the soul, <bdi>الرُّوح</bdi>: al-Nawawī — {{c1::a delicate substance interwoven with the human body}}; al-Ghazālī — {{c2::an independent substance that traverses the body}}

arbaeen_ahadith.front: How much knowledge of the soul, <bdi>الرُّوح</bdi>, have we been given?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: Very little — <bdi>وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ العِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا</bdi> (al-Isrāʾ 17:85)

arbaeen_ahadith.front: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, what does the <bdi>رِزْق</bdi> written for each person cover?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: Everything they will receive: wealth, food, water, shelter, clothing and provisions

arbaeen_ahadith.front: What follows from a person's <bdi>رِزْق</bdi> being written before birth?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: They will receive neither more nor less than what was decided

arbaeen_ahadith.front: What follows from a person's <bdi>أَجَل</bdi>, their lifespan, being written before birth?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: They will not leave this world a moment earlier or later than decided

arbaeen_ahadith.front: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, which of a person's deeds are written?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: All of them — good or bad, big or small, public or private

arbaeen_ahadith.front: In the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, what does “wretched or happy” — <bdi>شَقِيّ أَمْ سَعِيد</bdi> — refer to?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: Where the person will end up in the hereafter: their salvation, or not

arbaeen_ahadith.front: What should the endings described in the ḥadīth of creation in the womb make us feel about our own?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: Uneasy — never complacent because we are doing well now; no one knows how they will leave

arbaeen_ahadith.front: In light of the ḥadīth of creation in the womb, what should we ask of Allah about our end?
arbaeen_ahadith.back: His help to a good ending — <bdi>حُسْن الخَاتِمَة</bdi> — and His protection from a bad one — <bdi>سُوء الخَاتِمَة</bdi>
